pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions exhibiting high contrast and sharp edge gradients. Individual patches show greater spatial area on the neck and upper flank, becoming smaller and more densely clustered toward the posterior and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating the dark patches. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way and four-way intersections. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a serrated 1D silhouette with a high frequency of low-amplitude hair bundles visible against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Two avian symbionts are perched directly on the dorsal ridge: one positioned on the mid-back and a second smaller bird located on the posterior dorsal region.
